dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Did I hear you talk about Wolvendom?

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Oh, yes. I did see something strange in Wolvendom not long ago.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: From the silhouette, it seemed to be a boy, but he was with a pack of wolves, and they seemed very close, too...

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Perhaps I was mistaken. I was quite a distance away, after all, and it was only a glimpse.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: I mean, how could humans live alongside wolves? How strange...
